# Introduction

Klossen is the upgraded form of Flametal mace using the Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
An upgraded Flametal mace will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
